purpose: Assemble one real MT5 Demo evidence package from independent fail-closed receipts.
required_invariants: submission must be DEMO and ACCEPTED with full fill
observation must independently report ACCEPTED with matching order/deal IDs
preflight must be PASS and read-only
runtime evidence must be PASS and RECONCILED
replay must show the trade CLOSED with no unresolved reconciliation
candidate_id and config_hash must match the frozen G13 package preflight
EA source SHA-256 must match the frozen G13 MQ5 hash in package preflight
